author: Yyglsiir
body: The town hall will give you quests to do which will increase the morale of your villagers(higher morale = better offerings in the citadel). You can have up to 20 residences will give you 5 villagers each. Imo you should build the town hall, then some or all of the residences, and lastly the citadel.

body: The gold in your keep also generates daily income, fyi.

author: NewsPlayful7413
body:
Gold income from storing gold is 1%. A fully upgraded castle (keep) can store 300,000,000 gold, earning 3M per day. 

But, as a T10 lvl 235 player (and you really have to get past 225 to make the orns to upgrade to castle), I typically earn 500 Million to 1 Billion gold per day.

So, yeah, in the upper levels, the gold earned from the castle is largely irrelevant. 

But in the lower levels, I found the income helpful.
